content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ESIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Contractual Specialists/ Senior Residents posts at ESIC Hospital Kala Amb is scheduled for 21st September 2026. Candidates must ensure they report on this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Contractual Specialists and Senior Residents?
faq.answer: There are a total of 42 vacancies announced by ESIC for the posts of Contractual Specialists and Senior Residents. These are distributed across different categories and specific roles.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: For Senior Resident posts, candidates need a PG Degree or Diploma in the concerned specialty from a recognized university. Non-PG candidates require 2 years of experience in the relevant department.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Contractual Specialists?
faq.answer: The age limit for Contractual Specialists is not exceeding 67 years. For Senior Residents, the maximum age limit is 45 years, with relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary structure for Contractual Specialists (Part-Time)?
faq.answer: Part-Time Contractual Specialists will receive a consolidated remuneration of ₹60,000/- per month for 16 hours per week, plus additional remuneration for emergency visits and extra duty hours.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for this recruitment drive. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any further details regarding fees.

faq.question: Q7. What documents are required at the time of the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring original certificates and one set of self-attested photocopies of relevant documents like Age, Qualification, Category, Experience, MCI/State Registration, and two recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the ESIC Hospital Kala Amb located?
faq.answer: ESIC Hospital Kala Amb is located in Kala Amb, Himachal Pradesh, with the pincode 173030. Candidates should plan their travel accordingly for the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Contractual Specialists/ Senior Residents posts will be based on a walk-in interview. Candidates will be assessed based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Himachal Pradesh apply?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify any domicile restrictions. Eligible candidates from all regions are encouraged to apply and attend the walk-in interview, provided they meet the eligibility criteria.
